items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: Yeah, I played with him once.

ctx.x: me when I would take trombone lessons. Sure does. George Fuclos. You used George Fuclos. I know where it was. Yeah, Franklin Street. It was right across from 25. 425. I had a band in there. Tommy Jimmy Noon was playing there one time. You know who was talking about Jimmy Noon? Sure, Jimbo. Jimbo. That's right, Jimbo.
I was talking to Arnold the Passer's wife about him. You remember Arnold the Passer drummer?

Yeah, yeah, yeah. He's good. Who did he play with? Your man? Yeah, I played with him once. We both. I was in the band he was playing in. What did he used to do? I said, how did he used to do? You see? He used to find musicians so fast in that day. Find high on some days. Well then, it's like you didn't follow you talk about the this man is still the leader. I might say. But now to find this fall out the band, don't you see? And taking him. I'm still in the band. There's so much of that not there. Thomas Benton,…
